n, b = map(int, input().split())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
cuts = []

even = 0
odd = 0

for i in range(n):
    if i != 0 and even == odd:
        cuts.append(abs(arr[i] - arr[i - 1]))
    if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
        even += 1
    else:
        odd += 1

cuts.sort()

count = 0
for cut in cuts:
    if cut <= b:
        count += 1
        b -= cut

print(count)
